title: Lightweight and warm
text: Lightweight and warm. Blanket is fine but it wasn't the color it showed.  It is actually an orange red which didn't match what I got them for.

product_metadata.title: J&M Home Fashions Premium Superior Fleece Blanket Throw, Full/Queen 90x90, Ultra Soft Cozy Warm Plush Fuzzy for Bed, Couch, Sofa, Camping, Beach-Olive Green
description: Whether you want extra layer of warmth in bed, or a handy blanket for guests, this super soft 90"x90" fleece blanket has you covered. It's made of super soft 100% polyester microfleece in a year-round weight. Machine wash, cold. Use mild detergent. Wash dark colors separately. Tumble dry on low. Only non-chlorine bleach when needed. Available in marsala and patriot blue too! Available in different sizes: Twin/Twin XL, Full/Queen and King.
